report.summary: Patient P-D002 (46F, Medicaid with transport benefit) screens positive for transportation difficulty and utility shutoff risk. Lives in a low-income census tract (17031300900) with 18.5% utility shutoff prevalence. Found community resources for both needs with eligibility notes.

options.name: Neighborhood Energy Help
options.how_to_access: Apply in person Mon/Wed for income-based help with gas and electric bills.

options.name: Shutoff Prevention Clinic
options.how_to_access: Walk-in help with disconnection notices, Tuesdays.

options.name: Medical certificate request (utility shutoff)
options.how_to_access: Clinic submits form to document medical need; responds within one business day.

options.name: Medicaid Ride Line
options.how_to_access: Call the number on the Medicaid card at least 2 business days ahead to schedule non-emergency medical transport.

options.name: Paratransit Info Desk
options.how_to_access: Apply for ADA paratransit certification by phone; decisions take up to 21 days.
